item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI plans to honor a shared signal in robots.txt for website operators’ preferences about the use of their content in foundational generative AI training.

The proposed signal would let operators communicate one preference to multiple participating providers. That could save publishers from maintaining separate rules for each company’s crawlers, while OpenAI’s existing crawler controls remain available.

Implementation is expected in the coming months, with further details to follow. The voluntary effort draws on the IETF AI Preferences working group and depends on providers choosing to honor the signal.</linkedin_post>
